subject.title: fix(doctor): guard snapshot store load against corrupt JSON

question: When the SSH cooldown map reaches its capacity, should OpenClaw retain every non-expired cooldown even if the map temporarily exceeds the cap, or intentionally evict active entries to preserve a hard bound?
rationale: The current patch computes expiry but does not use it, and either behavior has a real tradeoff between retry suppression and bounded memory; this is not safe to choose silently in a drive-by fix.

options.title: Preserve active cooldowns
options.body: Only remove expired entries and define a bounded-overflow policy that never shortens an active cooldown.

options.title: Keep a hard cap
options.body: Evict active entries only with an explicit documented policy and focused tests that establish the accepted early-retry behavior.

options.title: Revert the gateway hunk
options.body: Keep this PR focused on malformed snapshot JSON and route cooldown-cap semantics to a dedicated gateway discussion.

recommendation.title: Preserve active cooldowns
recommendation.body: Only remove expired entries and define a bounded-overflow policy that never shortens an active cooldown.

likelyOwner.reason: The required choice defines gateway node-pairing behavior rather than merely correcting syntax or test coverage.
